name: Hunter-Killer Positrox

abilities.name: Concussion
abilities.description: A basic melee attack dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Charged Gore
abilities.description: The fabricant rushes at you and impales you with its horn, dealing high physical damage and bleed damage over time.

abilities.name: Rending Leap
abilities.description: The fabricant leaps at you if standing further away, dealing high physical damage and knocking you on the ground.

abilities.name: Shock Lash
abilities.description: The fabricant swipes its tail at you, dealing high physical damage. The tail swipe produces a wave of traveling lightning, which leads into the next ability, Static Cascade.

abilities.name: Residual Static
abilities.description: The fabricant headbutts the ground, causing a field of electricity to appear, indicated by a large circular AoE, dealing continuous high shock damage.

abilities.name: Static Cascade
abilities.description: Getting hit by the traveling lightning from Shock Lash deals high shock damage each

abilities.name: Empowering Beam
abilities.description: A beam of blue energy forms when the two fabricants are close together, greatly increasing their damage output.

abilities.name: Summons Spheres
abilities.description: Throughout the fight, Refabricated Spheres will appear in the arena to aid the bosses. They are buffed with an impenetrable damage shield. The only way to remove the shield is to bring the bosses close together to arm their Empowering Beam, and make the beam touch the spheres, which instantly removes the damage shield.

abilities.name: Summon Shalks
abilities.description: At 75%/50%/25% health (of the combined heath bar), a large swarm of Shalk Fabricants are summoned into the arena to aid the bosses.

abilities.name: Snap
abilities.description: If one of the bosses is killed while the other is alive, the remaining fabricant enters an enraged state that massively increases their outgoing damage, to a near lethal-level.

notes: If the entire party is wiped and Positrox is killed while Negatrix isn't (or vice versa), they will both respawn at full health.
Both Hunter-Killers appear in the Clockwork City card set from the story expansion Return to Clockwork City for Legends, as the card Hunter-Killers.
related_quests: Forging the Future: Stem the tide of fabricants before they overwhelm Tel Fyr.
summary: Hunter-Killer Positrox is a verminous fabricant who, together with Hunter-Killer Negatrix, acts as the first boss of the Halls of Fabrication. If both Fabricants are close to each other, they form a link which strengthens them,[verification needed] but also is the only way to dispel the damage shield on the Refabricated Spheres that spawn during the fight. It is advised that one tank keeps one of the Fabricants in the middle of the room, while the other tank kites the second one around, creating the link to destroy any spheres that spawns. They will also cause a debuff which drains more health the longer it is active, and should be dispelled as soon as possible. Once they are killed, a chest spawns at the front of the room they are in. The Pinnacle Factotum appears from the planar rift shortly afterwards.
